## Install

Download the **`-setup.exe`** file below and run it. It installs for your user account, with no administrator rights
needed, makes Print Screen start a dvsnip snip, and adds `dvsnip-cli` to your Path. Running it over an existing install
updates it in place. Uninstall from Apps & features; Print Screen goes back to Windows.

The **`-portable.exe`** file is `dvsnip.exe` alone: run it from anywhere and it takes Print Screen until you run
`dvsnip.exe --quit`. Each `.sha256` file holds the SHA-256 checksum of its download.
